name: Solitude Apartments
summary: A quieter approach to a city stay.
description: Deep green, warm cream and generous photography make the apartments the focus. The pages move from discovering the spaces to choosing a stay.

name: Triptick Logistics
summary: Parcel dispatch for people and businesses.
description: The opening explains the service straight away. Booking, parcel information and the business offering each have their own place in the page.

name: Make Me Beauty Place
summary: A salon website in black and gold.
description: Hair photography leads the design. Service cards, a gallery and appointment prompts give visitors different ways to explore the salon.

name: ZestéFoods
summary: Food, meal plans and everyday ordering.
description: The food appears early and often. Meal choices and plans are presented in separate sections, with clear routes towards the next step.

name: Aylustre Expressions
description: Cobalt blue type and close-up photography give the pages a strong identity. Bridal services and training are presented as two distinct parts of the offering.

name: Dear Didi Beauty
description: The layout gives the makeup work room to speak. Warm neutrals frame the portfolio, while services and enquiries are kept easy to find.

name: ORÍ
summary: Hair services and a booking interaction.
description: The salon concept pairs an editorial layout with a filterable service menu and booking preview. It is a frontend demonstration, not a live appointment system.

name: Topcars Abuja
description: A dark palette and lime accents frame the cars. The page connects vehicle discovery with purchase and selling enquiries.

name: Apricot Apartments
summary: A city stay, with room to explore.
description: The apartment catalogue and location choices do most of the explaining. Warm colours, spacious layouts and interior photography keep the focus on the stay.
